name: Engineering contract acceptance management
type: AM Platform / engineering contracts / acceptance control
scope: Server-side project scope and role gates
requiresDatabases: Engineering contract PostgreSQL schema v9 or later

dataIsolation.guard: Acceptance evidence references and event rows remain tenant-scoped in the dedicated Engineering contract database; raw evidence files remain in their existing private storage.

definitionOfDone: Acceptance items are derived only from frozen contract versions
Evidence-required submissions contain immutable references and SHA-256 hashes
Submit, review, and reopen commands enforce server-side scope and roles
Events are append-only and hash-linked without a mutable overwrite path
Focused acceptance dry-run passes before production installation
